# CoiPatrol

> CoiPatrol is certificate of insurance (COI) tracking software for small construction and property firms. Upload an ACORD 25 PDF, CoiPatrol reads the policy dates and limits, shows every subcontractor on a green, yellow and red dashboard, and emails renewal reminders automatically. Free for up to 20 subcontractors, $49 a month for up to 50 (Growth plan), $99 a month for up to 250 (Pro plan), $199 a month for up to 1,000 (Business plan). 14-day trial on paid plans, card at checkout, nothing charged for 14 days. First month 10% off on monthly plans. No sales call.

Pricing in full (USD, flat, not per vendor). Free is the door, paid plans do the chasing for you:
- Free: $0, up to 20 subcontractors, no credit card. AI reading of every certificate (scans too), a private upload link per sub, the dashboard, CSV import and export, certificates by email, the weekly summary, certificate history, one login and a one-click Send reminder button per sub
- Growth, up to 50 subcontractors: $49 a month, $140 every 3 months, $265 every 6 months, $490 a year
- Pro, up to 250 subcontractors: $99 a month, $282 every 3 months, $534 every 6 months, $990 a year
- Business, up to 1,000 subcontractors: $199 a month, $567 every 3 months, $1,075 every 6 months, $1,990 a year
- Every paid plan adds: automatic renewal reminders at 30, 14, 7 days, the day of and after a lapse, the email to the sub saying what to fix, requirements by trade, team members (owners and viewers), the audit ZIP, your own reminder wording and schedule, and emails sent as your company
- Paid plans: 14-day trial, card at checkout, nothing charged for 14 days. First month 10% off on monthly plans. Yearly is 2 months free

Limits, stated honestly: no carrier-direct policy verification, no managed review team, built for up to 1,000 subcontractors.

## Product
- [Home](https://coipatrol.com/): what CoiPatrol does and who it is for
- [Pricing](https://coipatrol.com/pricing/): public pricing, Free, Growth ($49 a month), Pro ($99 a month) and Business ($199 a month), with 3-month, 6-month and yearly options

## Free tools
- [Free COI tracking spreadsheet](https://coipatrol.com/free-coi-tracking-spreadsheet/): ungated Excel and Google Sheets template with red, yellow and green expiration rules
- [COI request email templates](https://coipatrol.com/coi-request-email-template/): five copy-and-paste emails (first request, renewal, missing endorsement, lapsed coverage, final notice) and an email generator
- [How to verify a certificate of insurance](https://coipatrol.com/how-to-verify-a-certificate-of-insurance/): field-by-field ACORD 25 checks, fake certificate red flags, and a checker that compares a certificate to your requirements
- [Workers' comp audit and uninsured subcontractors](https://coipatrol.com/workers-comp-audit-subcontractors/): how uninsured subs are added to your payroll at audit, with a premium estimate calculator
